jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a) inventory: Georgia School District, a town school district in the Franklin West Supervisory Union (member town: Georgia).

sources.note: Georgia (GEMS) School Board page (Franklin West SU, official): five directors -- Carl Laroe (Chair), J.C. Thouin (Clerk), Grady Ballard, Lisa Mattos, Richard Dickinson. NO MEMBERSHIPS ARE RECORDED for this district: two official FWSU vacancy notices show TWO seats filled by appointment on April 14, 2026 and ONE more on May 5, 2026 (all to March 2027), and no fetched official source names the appointees or identifies which of the five page-listed members are elected and which appointed. The exact missing documents are the GEMS board minutes of April 14 and May 5, 2026. Laroe, Thouin and Ballard are documented as sitting directors on March 10, 2026 (signatures on the FY27 revote warning). The board is five directors at-large (16 V.S.A. section 423(a)-(b); FWSU's official 2017 Alternative Structure Application to the State Board of Education states each Franklin West district 'maintains a 5-person board of school directors'.)
